title: Nanum CSV Viewer localization catalog
description: One UTF-8 JSON object per supported language, named <languageCode>.json. Keys are English source templates; values are translated templates. Swift interpolations become zero-based numbered placeholders {0}, {1}, etc. Each placeholder must occur exactly as often as in its English key; order may change. Literal braces are escaped as {{ and }}. Preserve printf conversion specifications exactly. Escaped JSON quotes and newlines represent actual source characters, not extra escaping. Run localization-catalog.swift --check to validate source parity, all language files, placeholder signatures and printf conversions.
